synopsis: A historical costume drama (wuxia) set in the fictional Great Yin Dynasty. The story follows Fan Changyu, a pragmatic butcher's daughter, and Xie Zheng, the Marquis of Wu'an hiding as a scholar named Yan Zheng to investigate the massacre of his family 16 years prior in the Jinzhou Incident. A matrilocal marriage of convenience evolves into love amidst political intrigue and war.
setting: Fictional Great Yin Dynasty. Core Conflict: The Jinzhou Incident (16 years prior) where Crown Prince Chengde and General Xie Linshan died due to withheld reinforcements, sparking a power struggle between the Wei Faction (Prime Minister Wei Yan) and the Li Faction.

Fan Changyu.description: Pragmatic butcher's daughter, ~18. Becomes female head of household after parents' death. Physically strong, wields a butcher's knife.

Xie Zheng.description: Marquis of Wu'an (Wu'an Hou). Hides identity as frail scholar 'Yan Zheng' to investigate family's massacre. Switches between gentle humble tone (as Yan Zheng) and authoritative commanding tone (as Marquis/General).

Wei Yan.description: Prime Minister, Xie Zheng's maternal uncle, primary antagonist. Leads the Wei Faction.

Lord Changxin.description: Prince Changxin, powerful political figure, Lord of Changxin.

He Jingyuan.description: General He, Prefect of Jizhou, Wei Yan's trusted advisor.

Wei Xuan.description: Wei Yan's son, cowardly and cruel.

Wei Qilin.description: General under Wei Yan, household military commander.

Li Huai'an.description: Grand Tutor's grandson, has unrequited feelings for Changyu.

Yu Qianqian.description: Changyu's loyal best friend, restaurant owner.

Cui Qianjin.description: Local woman, knows the Fan family.

Kang Dan.description: Writes spring festival couplets, local scholar.

Crown Prince Chengde.description: Died in Jinzhou Incident 16 years ago.

General Xie Linshan.description: Xie Zheng's father, died in Jinzhou Incident.

formality.note: German formal/informal address. Ancient China setting: use formal Sie for servants→masters, commoners→officials, strangers, formal audiences. Use informal du for these character pairs:
informal_pairs: Fan Changyu ↔ Yan Zheng/Xie Zheng (married couple)
Fan Changyu ↔ Song Yan (former fiance, still informal)
Fan Changyu ↔ Fuling (mistress to maid, downward)
Yu Qianqian ↔ Yan Zheng (friends by association)
always_formal: Anyone to Lord Changxin, Marquis of Wu'an, Prime Minister Wei Yan, General He
Younger to elder in formal settings
